records.text: A viewer using the handle Central848 proposed that Charlie Kirk was electrocuted and that current passing through his necklace created the neck wound, citing photographs that appeared to show charred hands.
records.speaker: Handle Central848 (identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: Central848 writes, Candace, please look into the possibility that Charlie (Charlie Kirk) was electrocuted and that the hole in his neck was made by the currents passing through his necklace and out of his throat. ... The images of his charred hands are conclusive and compelling. Please, for the love of God, look into this.

verification.notes: Verified only as attribution of a viewer theory read on the episode. It does not verify electrocution, electrical neck injury, or charred hands.

sources.title: Erika And I Sat Down. Here’s What Happened. | Candace Ep 280
sources.relevance: Primary episode records Owens reading Central848’s electrocution theory and its charred-hands premise.
